title: repo-analyst source answer
description: One answer to a source question, with every claim bound to captured bytes.

answer.description: The answer, in prose, to the question in the task input.

citations.description: Source-backed citations. A citation names the provider alias and the snapshot hash beside its path and line range, so evidence stays attributable when one answer combines several immutable sources. Every citation present must be complete: a partial citation is not evidence. An empty array is the honest encoding of an answer that no source supports a positive claim about — reporting that a literal is absent is a real answer, and requiring a citation for it would only reward inventing one.

provider.description: Installed provider alias the evidence came from, such as workspace.

snapshot_hash.description: Snapshot hash carried by the result that produced this citation.

path.description: Relative path inside the captured snapshot.

lines.description: Inclusive first and last line number that were actually read.
